title: kith-tui: prev_selected updated on chat-switch load failure, blocking retry
description: In event.rs run(), when the user switches chats and load_messages_for_chat returns is_error=true, the code sets connection_status=Error but still executes prev_selected=state.selected_chat. On all subsequent ticks, prev_selected==state.selected_chat so the reload branch is never re-entered. The user is permanently stuck seeing messages from the previously selected chat until they switch away and back. Fix: only advance prev_selected inside the else branch (successful load), so the next tick retries the failed load.
